import AppKit

// The integration suite exercises native clipboard data and must run with that service available.
let pasteboard =
  NSPasteboard.perform(NSSelectorFromString("pasteboardWithUniqueName"))?.takeUnretainedValue()
  as? NSPasteboard
let marker = UUID().uuidString
let available =
  pasteboard?.setString(marker, forType: .string) == true
  && pasteboard?.string(forType: .string) == marker
pasteboard?.releaseGlobally()
if !available {
  let message = """
    현재 실행 환경에서 macOS 클립보드 쓰기·읽기가 동작하지 않습니다.
    macOS에서 직접 연 Ghostty 또는 Terminal 앱에서 ./scripts/check.sh를 실행해 주세요.
    실제 클립보드를 사용하는 통합 검사는 생략하지 않고, 검사와 게시를 중단합니다.

    """
  FileHandle.standardError.write(Data(message.utf8))
  exit(1)
}

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

script_directory="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
project_directory="$(cd -- "$script_directory/.." && pwd)"

cd "$project_directory"
xcrun swift-format lint --strict --recursive Package.swift Sources Tests scripts/generate-app-icon.swift scripts/check-system-services.swift
for script in scripts/*.sh; do
  bash -n "$script"
done
plutil -lint Resources/Info.plist
xcrun swift scripts/check-system-services.swift
"$script_directory/build-app.sh" release
codesign --verify --strict "$project_directory/build/release/Chop.app"
icon_name="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleIconFile' "$project_directory/build/release/Chop.app/Contents/Info.plist")"
iconset_path="$project_directory/build/icon-check.iconset"
rm -rf -- "$iconset_path"
iconutil -c iconset "$project_directory/build/release/Chop.app/Contents/Resources/$icon_name" -o "$iconset_path"
# AppKit windows and the terminal engine share process state across async UI tests.
swift test --no-parallel
echo "All checks passed."
